scripts.docker:all:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis postgres_test redis_test
scripts.project:bootstrap: yarn project:install && yarn plugin:publish:local && yarn project:plugin:add && yarn project:db:migrate
scripts.project:db:migrate: sh -c 'if test "$DEVCONTAINER" = "true"; then DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 yarn --cwd apps/dev-app db:migrate; else yarn --cwd apps/dev-app db:migrate; fi'
scripts.project:dev: sh -c 'if test "$DEVCONTAINER" = "true"; then DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 node ./scripts/project-dev.mjs; else node ./scripts/project-dev.mjs; fi'
scripts.project:dev:medusa: sh -c 'if test "$DEVCONTAINER" = "true"; then DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 yarn --cwd apps/dev-app dev; else yarn --cwd apps/dev-app dev; fi'
scripts.project:seed: sh -c 'if test "$DEVCONTAINER" = "true"; then DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 yarn --cwd apps/dev-app seed; else yarn --cwd apps/dev-app seed; fi'
